rows.description: Our next-generation, interactive app is currently in beta!  Come try it out at terminalthemes.com! Over 850 terminal color schemes/themes for iTerm, with ports to Terminal, Konsole, PuTTY, Xresources, XRDB, Remmina, Termite, XFCE, Tilda, FreeBSD VT, Terminator, Kitty, Windows, Visual Studio,, Ghostty, and dozens more
An inky color scheme for prose and code.

Graphical application for generating different color variations of Oomox (Numix-based) theme (GTK2, GTK3, Cinnamon, GNOME, Openbox, Xfwm), Archdroid, Gnome-Color, Numix, Papirus and Suru++ icon themes. Have a hack for HiDPI in gtk2. Its Base16 plugin also allowing a lot of app themes support like Alacritty, Emacs, GTK4, KDE, VIM and many more.
